checks: manual create preserves identifiers, NAV and audit separately
employees cannot see another owner through table, search or statistics
forged ownership, metadata and direct writes are rejected
bad timestamps, negative NAV, missing contact and unsupported status rejected
cross-midnight calls and no-answer with no end are accepted
follow-up assigned to another employee grants read but not call edit
stale task changes and call edits cannot overwrite completion
reopening a follow-up clears completion and updates version
Vietnamese search, exact customer history, ranges and keyset pagination
statistics count unique customer keys and exclude unanswered duration
due-today, overdue and upcoming use Vietnamese dates
read and viewer can report but cannot save/import/manage purposes
manager sees all, reassigns owner and manages purposes
import preview reports row errors and scoped duplicate warnings
import commits atomically and repeats same request without duplicate writes
reused request with different payload is rejected
changed duplicate warnings require renewed confirmation
mixed invalid import never writes partially and import results are private
revoked permissions apply immediately with unchanged JWT
deleting source call preserves later call and removes only its task
anonymous and inactive accounts cannot read or invoke writes
